name: 📚 图书馆
desc: 开放时间·借阅·罚款·安静区·预约·数据库·打印·续借·馆际互借

items.en: The library opens at eight.
items.zh: 图书馆八点开门。

items.en: Please return your books on time.
items.zh: 请按时归还图书。

items.en: You can borrow up to ten books.
items.zh: 你最多可以借十本书。

items.en: The quiet rooms are upstairs.
items.zh: 安静自习室在楼上。

items.en: Printing costs ten cents a page.
items.zh: 打印每页一角钱。

items.en: You may renew books online.
items.zh: 你可以在线续借图书。

items.en: Please keep your voice down.
items.zh: 请小声说话。

items.en: Late returns are charged a small daily fine.
items.zh: 逾期归还每天收取少量罚金。

items.en: The quiet study rooms are on the third floor.
items.zh: 安静自习室在三楼。

items.en: You can reserve a group room at the front desk.
items.zh: 你可以在前台预约小组研讨室。

items.en: Our online databases are free for all students.
items.zh: 我们的在线数据库对全体学生免费。

items.en: Please log in with your student ID first.
items.zh: 请先用你的学生证登录。

items.en: Food and drinks are not allowed near the computers.
items.zh: 电脑区附近禁止携带食物和饮料。

items.en: Each book can be renewed twice before the deadline.
items.zh: 每本书在到期前可续借两次。

items.en: If a book is checked out, you can place a hold and we will email you.
items.zh: 如果书已被借走，你可以预约，我们会邮件通知你。
chunks: If a book is checked out

items.en: Reference books, which cannot leave the building, must be used at the tables here.
items.zh: 参考书不能带出楼外，必须在这里的桌子上使用。
chunks: must be used at the tables here

items.en: When you return a book late, the fine grows by a dime each day.
items.zh: 当你逾期还书时，罚金每天增加一角钱。
chunks: When you return a book late

items.en: If we don't own the title, we can request a copy through interlibrary loan.
items.zh: 如果我们没有这本书，可以通过馆际互借调取一册。
chunks: If we don't own the title

items.en: Students who need to print in color should use the machine by the entrance.
items.zh: 需要彩色打印的学生应使用入口旁的那台机器。
chunks: Students who need to print in color

items.en: Because the database is busy, you may lose access when too many people log in.
items.zh: 由于数据库繁忙，登录人数过多时你可能会掉线。
chunks: when too many people log in

items.en: During the final exam week, the reading room stays open until midnight so students can study.
items.zh: 期末考试周期间，阅览室开放至午夜，方便学生学习。
chunks: the reading room stays open until midnight
